xmldoc.short_description: Resets the answers saved by uigetpref dialogs.

param_input_item.param_description: a character vector or scalar string: the only supported command (case insensitive).

param_output_item.param_description: a struct with all the stored preferences after the reset, organized by group as returned by getpref().

description.p: uisetpref('clearall') sets back to 'ask' every preference that has been used by a uigetpref dialog. The next call to uigetpref for these preferences shows the dialog again.
Preferences created only with setpref or addpref are not changed. Any other command raises an error.
uisetpref does not open a dialog and also works without the graphical interface.

example_item.example_item_description: Reset the saved dialog answers so that the questions are asked again.
